name: 3/4 sit-up
description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Place your hands behind your head. Engage your core and lift your upper body towards your knees, stopping at a 3/4 position. Lower back down with control.

name: 45° side bend
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Hold a weight in one hand and lean to the side, bending at the waist to bring the weight down towards your knee. Return to the starting position and repeat. Alternate sides.

name: air bike
description: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and legs raised. Bring one knee towards your chest while twisting your torso to touch the opposite elbow to that knee. Alternate sides in a pedaling motion.

name: alternate heel touchers
description: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat. Lift your shoulders off the ground and reach towards your right heel, then to your left. Keep alternating sides while engaging your core.

name: alternate lateral pulldown
description: Sit at a cable machine with the bar set above you. Grab the bar with a wide grip. Pull the bar down to your chest, alternating between each side, engaging your lats throughout.

name: assisted chest dip (kneeling)
description: Kneel on the assisted dip machine. Grip the handles and lower your body until your elbows are at a 90-degree angle. Push back up to the starting position.

name: assisted hanging knee raise with throw down
description: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms straight. Engage your core and raise your knees towards your chest, then lower them back down with control, adding a gentle throw down motion.

name: assisted hanging knee raise
description: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms straight. Engage your core and raise your knees towards your chest. Lower your legs back down slowly.

name: assisted lying leg raise with lateral throw down
description: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Lift your legs towards the ceiling and then lower them to the side in a controlled manner, returning to the center before lowering back down.

name: assisted lying leg raise with throw down
description: Lie on your back with your legs extended. Lift your legs towards the ceiling, then lower them while adding a gentle throw down motion to engage your core effectively.

name: assisted motion russian twist
description: Sit on the ground with your knees bent and lean back slightly. Hold a medicine ball and rotate your torso to touch the ball to the ground on each side, using the assistance to control the movement.

name: assisted parallel close grip pull-up
description: Use an assisted pull-up machine. Grip the close handles, lower your body, and then pull yourself up using your lats. Use the assistance to complete the movement.

name: assisted prone hamstring
description: Lie face down on an assisted hamstring curl machine. Position your legs under the pad and curl them towards your glutes, using the assistance to control the movement.

name: assisted pull-up
description: Stand on the assisted pull-up machine. Grip the handles and pull yourself up while using the assistance to lower your body back down in a controlled manner.

name: assisted standing triceps extension (with towel)
description: Stand holding a towel attached to an overhead cable. Pull the towel down behind your head while keeping your elbows close to your ears. Return to the starting position.

name: assisted triceps dip (kneeling)
description: Kneel on the assisted dip machine. Grip the handles and lower your body down while keeping your elbows close. Push back up to the starting position.

name: backward lunge
description: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart. Step back with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at about a 90-degree angle. Push through the front heel to return to the starting position.

name: bench press
description: Lie on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand. Lower the weights to your chest, keeping your elbows at a 45-degree angle. Press the weights back up to the starting position.

name: bent over row
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell. Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips. Pull the barbell towards your abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower it back down.

name: cable crunch
description: Kneel in front of a cable machine with the rope attachment. Grasp the rope and pull it down towards your knees while curling your spine. Return to the starting position.

name: barbell bench press
description: Lie flat on a bench with your feet firmly on the ground. Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart. Lower the barbell to your chest slowly, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.

name: barbell bench squat
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell across your upper back. Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor. Press back up through your heels, keeping your chest upright and core tight.

name: barbell bent over row
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent. Hold the barbell with an overhand grip, hinge forward at your hips, and row the barbell toward your lower chest. Keep your back straight and elbows close to your body.

name: barbell clean and press
description: Start by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell at your thighs. Explosively pull the barbell to shoulder height, then press it overhead. Lower the barbell back to your shoulders, then to the starting position.

name: barbell clean-grip front squat
description: Hold the barbell across your chest with your elbows high, using a clean grip. Lower into a squat by pushing your hips back and bending your knees. Keep your chest up and back straight as you drive back up to the starting position.

name: barbell close-grip bench press
description: Lie flat on a bench with a narrow grip on the barbell. Lower the barbell slowly to your chest while keeping your elbows close to your sides. Press the barbell back up, fully extending your arms to engage your triceps.

name: barbell curl
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with an underhand grip. Curl the barbell toward your chest, keeping your elbows close to your torso. Lower the barbell back down with control to the starting position.

name: barbell deadlift
description: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and grip the barbell with both hands. Hinge at your hips and lower the bar to mid-shin. Drive through your heels and extend your hips to stand tall, keeping the bar close to your body.

name: barbell decline bench press
description: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured. Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width apart and lower it toward your chest. Press the barbell back up while keeping your elbows slightly flared to target your chest muscles.

name: barbell decline bent arm pullover
description: Lie on a decline bench with the barbell extended over your chest. Lower the barbell behind your head while keeping your arms bent. Pull the barbell back up to the starting position by engaging your lats and upper back.

name: barbell decline close grip to skull press
description: Lie on a decline bench and hold the barbell with a close grip. Lower the barbell toward your forehead by bending your elbows. Press the barbell back up using your triceps, keeping your elbows tucked in throughout the movement.

name: barbell decline wide-grip press
description: Lie on a decline bench with a wide grip on the barbell. Lower the barbell slowly toward your lower chest, flaring your elbows out to engage your pectorals. Press the barbell back up, focusing on squeezing your chest muscles at the top.

name: barbell decline wide-grip pullover
description: Lie on a decline bench and hold the barbell with a wide grip. Lower the barbell behind your head while keeping your arms slightly bent. Engage your lats and pull the barbell back to the starting position over your chest.

name: barbell drag curl
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding the barbell with an underhand grip. Instead of curling the barbell directly, drag it along your torso, focusing on squeezing your biceps throughout the movement. Lower the barbell back down slowly.

name: barbell front chest squat
description: Hold the barbell across the front of your shoulders with your elbows raised high. Squat down while keeping your torso upright and core tight. Drive through your heels to return to a standing position, engaging your glutes throughout.

name: barbell front raise and pullover
description: Stand with your feet hip-width apart and hold the barbell in front of you. Raise the barbell overhead, then lower it behind your head in a pullover motion. Return the barbell to the front and repeat, focusing on chest activation throughout.

name: barbell front raise
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell in front of your thighs. Raise the barbell to shoulder height while keeping your arms straight. Lower the barbell slowly to the starting position, focusing on your deltoids.

name: barbell front squat
description: Hold the barbell across your front shoulders with your elbows high. Squat down by bending at the knees and hips, keeping your torso upright. Drive back up through your heels to the standing position, engaging your glutes and quads.

name: barbell full squat
description: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell across your back. Squat down until your thighs are below parallel to the floor. Press back up to the starting position, keeping your core tight and chest lifted throughout the movement.

name: barbell good morning
description: Stand with the barbell across your upper back and feet shoulder-width apart. Hinge at your hips and lower your torso while keeping your back flat. Return to the starting position by extending your hips and squeezing your hamstrings and glutes.

name: barbell guillotine bench press
description: Lie flat on a bench with a barbell. Hold the bar with a wide grip above your neck (not chest). Lower it slowly toward your throat, keeping elbows flared out, then press back up to the starting position.

name: barbell hack squat
description: Hold a barbell behind your legs with an overhand grip. Stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping the bar close to your body, then push through your heels to stand back up.

name: barbell incline bench press
description: Lie on an incline bench set at a 30-45 degree angle. Grip the barbell slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your upper chest, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.

name: barbell incline reverse-grip press
description: Lie on an incline bench with a barbell. Use a reverse (underhand) grip. Lower the bar to your upper chest, keeping elbows tucked, then press it back up, focusing on triceps engagement.

name: barbell incline row
description: Lie face down on an incline bench, holding a barbell with an overhand grip. Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower it back down with control.

name: barbell incline shoulder raise
description: Lie on an incline bench holding a barbell with a wide grip. Raise the bar overhead by protracting your shoulders (pushing them forward), then lower it back to the starting position.

name: barbell jefferson squat
description: Stand over a barbell with one foot on either side. Squat down to grab it with one hand in front and one behind. Stand up by driving through your heels, keeping your torso upright, then lower back down.

name: barbell jm bench press
description: Lie on a flat bench with a barbell. Use a narrow grip (hands close together). Lower the bar to just above your lower chest, keeping elbows tucked, then press it back up, emphasizing triceps.

name: barbell jump squat
description: Rest a barbell across your upper back. Squat down until thighs are parallel to the ground, then explosively jump upward, landing softly and immediately descending into the next squat.

name: barbell lunge
description: Place a barbell on your upper back. Step forward with one leg, lowering your hips until both knees are bent at 90 degrees. Push back through your front heel to return to standing, then switch legs.

name: barbell lying close-grip press
description: Lie on a flat bench with a barbell. Use a narrow grip. Lower the bar to your chest, keeping elbows close to your body, then press it back up, focusing on triceps contraction.

name: barbell lying close-grip triceps extension
description: Lie on a bench holding a barbell with a narrow grip. Extend the bar overhead, then bend at the elbows to lower it toward your forehead. Extend your arms back to the starting position.

name: barbell lying extension
description: Lie on a bench with a barbell held overhead. Keeping upper arms stationary, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then extend your arms back up.

name: barbell lying lifting (on hip)
description: Lie on your back with a barbell resting across your hips. Bend your knees, feet flat on the floor. Lift your hips by driving through your heels until your body forms a straight line, then lower back down.

name: barbell lying preacher curl
description: Lie face down on a preacher bench with a barbell. Grip the bar with an underhand grip, arms extended. Curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower it back down with control.

name: barbell lying triceps extension skull crusher
description: Lie on a bench with a barbell overhead. Keeping upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead, then extend your arms back to the starting position.

name: barbell lying triceps extension
description: Lie on a bench holding a barbell overhead. Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows, keeping upper arms stationary, then extend your arms back up.

name: barbell narrow stance squat
description: Place a barbell on your upper back. Stand with feet closer than shoulder-width. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight, then push back up through your heels.

name: barbell one arm bent over row
description: Bend forward at the hips, holding a barbell with one hand. Pull the bar toward your torso, keeping your elbow close, then lower it back down. Switch arms after reps.

name: barbell one arm floor press
description: Lie on the floor with a barbell in one hand. Press the bar upward from chest level until your arm is extended, then lower it back down. Switch arms after reps.

name: barbell one arm side deadlift
description: Stand beside a barbell, gripping it with one hand. Bend at the hips and knees to lift it off the ground, keeping it close to your side, then lower it back down.

name: barbell one arm snatch
description: Stand with a barbell in one hand. Explosively lift it from the ground to overhead in one motion, using your legs and shoulders, then lower it back down with control.

name: barbell one leg squat
description: Place a barbell on your upper back. Lift one leg off the ground and squat down on the other, keeping your torso upright, then push back up to standing.

name: barbell overhead squat
description: Hold a barbell overhead with a wide grip. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping the bar stable and your chest up, then stand back up.

name: barbell preacher curl
description: Sit at a preacher bench with a barbell. Grip it underhand and rest your upper arms on the pad. Curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower it back down slowly.

name: barbell press sit-up
description: Lie on your back holding a barbell above your chest. Perform a sit-up while pressing the bar upward, then lower both your body and the bar back down.

name: barbell prone incline curl
description: Lie face down on an incline bench with a barbell. Grip it underhand and curl it toward your shoulders, keeping elbows stationary, then lower it back down.

name: barbell pullover
description: Lie on a bench holding a barbell overhead. Lower the bar behind your head in an arc, feeling a stretch in your lats, then pull it back over to the starting position.

name: barbell rack pull
description: Set a barbell on a rack at knee height. Grip it overhand, then lift by extending your hips and knees, keeping your back straight, and lower it back to the rack.

name: barbell rear delt raise
description: Bend forward at the hips holding a barbell. Raise it outward to shoulder height, focusing on your rear delts, then lower it back down with control.

name: barbell rear delt row
description: Bend forward at the hips with a barbell. Pull it toward your upper abdomen, flaring elbows out to target rear delts, then lower it back down.

name: barbell rear lunge v. 2
description: Place a barbell on your upper back. Step backward with one leg, lowering your hips until your front knee is at 90 degrees, then push back to standing.

name: barbell rear lunge
description: With a barbell on your upper back, step back with one leg, bending both knees to 90 degrees. Push through your front heel to return to the starting position.

name: barbell reverse wrist curl v. 2
description: Sit with a barbell, palms facing down, resting forearms on your thighs. Curl your wrists upward, lifting the bar, then lower it back down slowly.

name: barbell reverse curl
description: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip. Curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping elbows close to your body, then lower it back down.

name: barbell reverse preacher curl
description: Sit at a preacher bench with a barbell, using an overhand grip. Rest arms on the pad and curl the bar toward your shoulders, then lower it back down.

name: barbell reverse wrist curl
description: Sit with a barbell, palms down, forearms on your thighs. Lift the bar by curling your wrists upward, then lower it back down with control.

name: barbell rollerout from bench
description: Kneel on a bench holding a barbell. Roll it forward, extending your body while keeping your core tight, then pull it back toward your knees.

name: barbell rollerout
description: Kneel on the floor with a barbell. Roll it forward, stretching your body out while engaging your abs, then use your core to pull it back to the starting position.

name: barbell romanian deadlift
description: Stand with a barbell in hand. Hinge at the hips, lowering the bar down your legs with a slight knee bend, then lift back up by driving your hips forward.

name: barbell seated behind head military press
description: Sit on a bench with a barbell resting on your upper back, behind your head, using a wide grip. Press the bar straight up until your arms are fully extended, then lower it back down with control to the starting position, keeping your core engaged throughout.

name: barbell seated bradford rocky press
description: Sit on a bench holding a barbell at shoulder height with a medium grip. Press the bar up and over your head to the back of your neck, then reverse the motion to bring it back to the front, alternating sides to engage your delts dynamically.

name: barbell seated calf raise
description: Sit on a bench with a barbell resting across your thighs, just above your knees, and your feet flat on the floor. Lift your heels by pushing through the balls of your feet to contract your calves, then lower them back down slowly for a full stretch.

name: barbell seated close-grip concentration curl
description: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with a close underhand grip, resting your elbows on your inner thighs. Curl the bar upward toward your chest, focusing on squeezing your biceps, then lower it back down slowly while maintaining control.

name: barbell seated good morning
description: Sit on a bench with a barbell across your upper back, feet flat on the floor. Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight, until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground, then return to the upright position by engaging your glutes and hamstrings.

name: barbell seated overhead press
description: Sit on a bench with back support, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip. Press the bar straight up overhead until your arms are fully extended, then lower it back to shoulder level, keeping your core tight to avoid arching your back.

name: barbell seated overhead triceps extension
description: Sit on a bench holding a barbell overhead with both hands, using a narrow grip. Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows, then extend your arms back up to the starting position, keeping your upper arms stationary throughout.

name: barbell seated twist
description: Sit on a bench holding a barbell across your shoulders with both hands. Rotate your torso to one side, engaging your obliques, then twist to the opposite side, keeping your hips stable and movements controlled.

name: barbell shrug
description: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, arms extended in front of you. Lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears as high as possible, then lower them back down slowly, keeping your arms straight throughout.

name: barbell side bent v. 2
description: Stand holding a barbell with one hand, resting it on your shoulder, and the other hand on your hip. Bend sideways at the waist toward the free side, engaging your obliques, then return to the upright position and switch sides.

name: barbell side split squat v. 2
description: Stand with a barbell on your upper back and take a wide stance with one leg extended to the side. Lower your hips toward the extended leg, bending the opposite knee, then push back up to the starting position, alternating sides.

name: barbell side split squat
description: Place a barbell across your upper back and step one leg out to the side, keeping the other leg straight. Bend the knee of the stepping leg to lower your body, then push back up through your heel to return to standing, switching sides as needed.

name: barbell single leg split squat
description: Rest a barbell on your upper back and place one foot behind you on a bench, keeping the other foot forward. Lower your hips by bending your front knee until your thigh is parallel to the ground, then push back up to the starting position.

name: barbell skier
description: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip at hip level, then bend slightly at the knees and hips. Swing the barbell upward in a controlled arc to shoulder height, mimicking a skiing motion, then lower it back down smoothly.

name: barbell speed squat
description: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet shoulder-width apart. Perform a squat by bending your knees and hips quickly, then explosively push back up to standing, focusing on speed while maintaining good form.

name: barbell squat (on knees)
description: Kneel on the ground with a barbell resting across your upper back, keeping your torso upright. Lower your hips toward your heels by bending your knees, then push back up to the starting position, engaging your quads throughout.

name: barbell standing ab rollerout
description: Stand holding a barbell with both hands at waist level, then bend at the hips to roll it forward along the ground, extending your body. Engage your core to pull the bar back toward your feet, returning to the standing position with control.

name: barbell standing back wrist curl
description: Stand holding a barbell behind your back with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you. Curl your wrists upward to lift the bar, contracting your forearms, then lower it back down slowly to stretch the muscles.

name: barbell standing bradford press
description: Stand holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip. Press it up and over your head to the back of your neck, then bring it back to the front in a continuous motion, keeping your core tight to stabilize.

name: barbell standing close grip curl
description: Stand with a barbell in hand, using a narrow underhand grip, keeping your elbows close to your body. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, squeezing your biceps at the top, then lower it back down with control.

name: barbell standing front raise over head
description: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip at thigh level, then raise it straight up in front of you until it’s overhead. Lower the bar back down slowly to the starting position, keeping your arms straight and shoulders engaged.

name: barbell standing leg calf raise
description: Stand with a barbell across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart, and toes pointing forward. Rise up onto the balls of your feet to lift your heels as high as possible, then lower them back down slowly to stretch your calves.

name: barbell standing overhead triceps extension
description: Stand holding a barbell overhead with both hands, using a narrow grip, and keep your elbows tucked in. Lower the bar behind your head by bending your elbows, then extend your arms back up to the starting position, focusing on triceps contraction.

name: barbell standing reverse grip curl
description: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand (reverse) grip, hands shoulder-width apart. Curl the bar upward toward your chest, engaging your biceps and forearms, then lower it back down slowly while keeping your elbows stationary.

name: barbell standing rocking leg calf raise
description: Stand with a barbell on your upper back, feet flat on the ground, then rise up onto your toes to lift your heels. Rock slightly forward and backward on the balls of your feet to fully engage your calves, then lower back down with control.

name: barbell standing twist
description: Stand holding a barbell across your shoulders with both hands, feet shoulder-width apart. Rotate your torso to one side, keeping your hips stable, then twist to the opposite side, engaging your obliques throughout the movement.

name: barbell standing wide-grip curl
description: Stand holding a barbell with an underhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart. Curl the bar up toward your shoulders, focusing on the outer biceps, then lower it back down slowly while keeping your elbows close to your body.

name: barbell step-up
description: Place a barbell across your upper back and stand in front of a sturdy bench or platform. Step up onto the bench with one foot, driving through your heel to lift your body, then step back down and repeat with the other leg.

name: barbell stiff leg good morning
description: Stand with a barbell on your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart, and knees slightly bent. Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your legs stiff and back straight, until your torso is nearly parallel to the ground, then return to standing by engaging your glutes.

name: barbell straight leg deadlift
description: Stand holding a barbell with an overhand grip, keeping your legs straight or with a slight bend. Lower the bar toward the floor by hinging at the hips, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings, then lift back up by driving your hips forward.

name: barbell sumo deadlift
description: Stand with a wide stance, toes pointed out, and grip a barbell with hands inside your knees. Lift the bar by extending your hips and knees, keeping your back straight, then lower it back down to the ground with control.

name: barbell reverse grip bent over row
description: Bend forward at the hips holding a barbell with an underhand grip, arms extended. Pull the bar toward your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then lower it back down while maintaining a strong back position.

name: barbell upright row v. 2
description: Stand holding a barbell with a narrow overhand grip, hands close together. Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows, then lower it back down to the starting position, keeping the movement controlled.

name: barbell upright row
description: Stand with a barbell in hand, using an overhand grip slightly narrower than shoulder-width. Lift the bar straight up to chest height, flaring your elbows out, then lower it back down slowly while keeping your core engaged.

name: barbell upright row v. 3
description: Stand holding a barbell with a medium overhand grip, hands about shoulder-width apart. Pull the bar upward toward your chin, keeping it close to your body, then lower it back down with control to target your delts effectively.

name: barbell wide bench press
description: Lie flat on a bench holding a barbell with a wide overhand grip, hands beyond shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your chest, then press it back up to the starting position, focusing on engaging your pectoral muscles throughout.

name: barbell wide-grip upright row
description: Stand holding a barbell with a wide overhand grip, hands well beyond shoulder-width. Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows, then lower it back down slowly to emphasize your shoulder muscles.

name: barbell wide squat
description: Place a barbell on your upper back and stand with feet wider than shoulder-width, toes slightly out. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up, then push back up through your heels to the starting position.

name: barbell wrist curl v. 2
description: Sit on a bench holding a barbell with an underhand grip, resting your forearms on your thighs, palms up. Curl your wrists upward to lift the bar, then lower it back down slowly to stretch and strengthen your forearms.

name: barbell wrist curl
description: Sit with a barbell in hand, using an underhand grip, and rest your forearms on your thighs with palms facing up. Lift the bar by curling your wrists upward, then lower it back down with control to target your forearm flexors.

name: barbell zercher squat
description: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell in the crook of your elbows, keeping your hands clasped near your chest. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight and chest up, then push back up through your heels to engage your glutes.

name: battling ropes
description: Stand with knees slightly bent, holding a thick rope in each hand with an overhand grip. Rapidly alternate raising and lowering each arm to create waves in the ropes, engaging your delts and core, and maintain a steady rhythm for the desired duration.

name: bench dip (knees bent)
description: Sit on the edge of a bench with hands gripping the edge beside your hips, knees bent, and feet flat on the floor. Slide your hips off the bench and lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up using your triceps to return to the starting position.

name: bench hip extension
description: Lie face down on a bench with your hips at the edge, legs hanging off, and hold the bench for support. Lift both legs upward by squeezing your glutes, keeping them straight, then lower them back down slowly to complete the rep.

name: body-up
description: Position yourself in a plank with forearms on the ground, then push up through your hands to fully extend your arms, lifting your body into a high plank position. Lower back down to your forearms with control, engaging your triceps throughout the movement.

name: bottoms-up
description: Lie on your back with arms by your sides, then lift your legs and hips off the ground, pushing your feet toward the ceiling to form a vertical line with your body. Lower your legs back down slowly without letting them touch the floor, keeping your abs engaged.

name: biceps narrow pull-ups
description: Hang from a pull-up bar with a close underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder-width apart. Pull your body up until your chin is above the bar, focusing on squeezing your biceps, then lower yourself back down with control.

name: biceps pull-up
description: Grip a pull-up bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart, and hang with arms fully extended. Pull yourself up by bending your elbows until your chin clears the bar, emphasizing your biceps, then lower back down slowly.

name: cable alternate shoulder press
description: Stand between two cable pulleys set at chest height, holding a handle in each hand. Press one handle upward until your arm is fully extended, then lower it back down while simultaneously pressing the other hand up, alternating to work your delts.

name: cable alternate triceps extension
description: Stand facing a high cable pulley with a handle in each hand, then extend one arm downward to straighten it, keeping your elbow stationary. Return to the starting position and repeat with the other arm, alternating to isolate your triceps.

name: cable bar lateral pulldown
description: Sit at a cable pulldown machine with a straight bar attached, gripping it wider than shoulder-width. Pull the bar down to your upper chest, keeping your elbows out to engage your lats, then return it slowly to the starting position.

name: cable bench press
description: Lie on a flat bench between two low cable pulleys, holding a handle in each hand at chest level. Press the handles upward until your arms are fully extended, squeezing your pecs, then lower them back down to the starting position.

name: cable concentration extension (on knee)
description: Kneel on one knee facing a high cable pulley, holding a handle with one hand and your elbow bent. Extend your arm downward to straighten it, focusing on your triceps, then return to the bent position and repeat.

name: cable cross-over lateral pulldown
description: Stand between two high cable pulleys, holding a handle in each hand with arms crossed in front of you. Pull the handles down and out to your sides until they reach chest level, engaging your lats, then return to the crossed position.

name: cable cross-over reverse fly
description: Stand between two high cable pulleys, holding the left handle with your right hand and the right handle with your left hand, arms crossed. Pull the handles outward and back in a wide arc to shoulder height, targeting your rear delts, then return to the starting position.

name: cable cross-over variation
description: Stand between two high cable pulleys, holding a handle in each hand with arms extended upward. Pull the handles down and across your body to meet at waist level, squeezing your pecs, then return to the starting position with control.

name: cable deadlift
description: Stand facing a low cable pulley with a straight bar attachment, gripping it with both hands. Hinge at the hips and bend your knees to lift the weight by straightening your body, engaging your glutes, then lower it back down smoothly.

name: cable decline fly
description: Lie on a decline bench between two high cable pulleys, holding a handle in each hand with arms extended upward. Pull the handles down and out in a wide arc until they meet above your lower chest, then return to the starting position, keeping your pecs engaged.

name: cable decline seated wide-grip row
description: Sit on a decline bench facing a cable machine with a wide-grip bar attached, leaning forward slightly. Pull the bar toward your upper abdomen, squeezing your shoulder blades together, then extend your arms back out with control.

name: cable floor seated wide-grip row
description: Sit on the floor facing a low cable pulley with a wide-grip bar, legs extended or slightly bent. Pull the bar toward your torso, keeping your back straight and engaging your upper back, then return to the starting position.

name: cable forward raise
